blocks.text: Open Computer Management → Network & Remote → Network Sharing. Sharing Status explains the installed roles. Connect to NFS Server and Disconnect from NFS Server operate only on the configured client share; disabled roles stay disabled.

/etc/network-sharing/config.json describes the installed policy. /etc/fstab contains the managed mount entries. The common sharing root is /data/sharing, with an account-level Sharing bind where configured. Paths and server roles depend on the selected host profile.

Running nfsmnt without arguments toggles the configured client connection; it can mount or unmount and is not a read-only probe. Close applications using the share before disconnecting. Filen uses its separate filenmnt account workflow.

Check Sharing Status, role enablement, the intended server and authorization agent. Server reachability is different from NFS export permission. A failed home bind can leave the source mounted; inspect status before retrying.
Do not mount arbitrary servers with sudo or edit exports to grant everyone access. Preserve numeric identity, firewall and profile ownership policy.
